title: Just one pillow
text: Just one pillow. Misleading picture. I thought I was buying 2 pillow COVERS. What I got: ONE PILLOW WITH ONE COVER ON IT. While it’s a beautiful pillow, obviously, I spent hours looking for the perfect ones, I was so disappointed that I returned it. Please change the photo and description to one pillow thank you.
